properties.name: Lakshadweep Coral Reef Sanctuary
properties.description: Strictly protected coral reef. 104 coral species. Fishing & anchoring prohibited.

properties.name: Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve
properties.description: UNESCO Biosphere. 3,600 species incl. dugongs, sea turtles, dolphins. Trawling banned.

properties.name: Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park (Andaman)
properties.description: Hawksbill turtles, saltwater crocodiles, rare corals. No-take zone.

properties.name: Whale Shark Aggregation (Gujarat Coast)
properties.description: Seasonal whale shark nursery. Endangered. Speed restriction: 10kn max.

properties.name: Blue Whale Migration Corridor (Arabian Sea)
properties.description: Pygmy blue whale route. Speed limits to prevent ship strikes.

properties.name: Olive Ridley Turtle Nesting (Odisha Coast)
properties.description: World's largest Olive Ridley nesting site. Trawling banned Nov–May.

properties.name: Chagos Archipelago Marine Reserve
properties.description: World's largest no-take marine reserve. 640,000 km². Critical for tuna, sharks, turtles.

properties.name: Maldives Shark Sanctuary
properties.description: Full shark & manta ray fishing ban since 2010. Critical reef ecosystem.

properties.name: Socotra Archipelago (Yemen)
properties.description: UNESCO Heritage. 'Galápagos of Indian Ocean'. 307 endemic species.

properties.name: Palk Strait Smuggling Corridor
properties.description: Known smuggling route India–Sri Lanka. Sea cucumber & endangered species trafficking.

properties.name: Somali Basin (Low Network)
properties.description: Poor AIS coverage. Historical IUU fishing & piracy. Satellite corroboration required.

properties.name: Strait of Hormuz Chokepoint
properties.description: High-traffic chokepoint. Geopolitical risk. AIS spoofing frequently detected.

properties.name: Great Barrier Reef Marine Park
properties.description: UNESCO Heritage. 344,400 km². 1,500 fish species, 400 coral species. Shipping lanes restricted.

properties.name: Papahānaumokuākea Marine Monument (Hawaii)
properties.description: 1,510,000 km² — one of largest MPAs on Earth. Hawaiian monk seals, green turtles. No extraction.

properties.name: Galápagos Marine Reserve
properties.description: UNESCO Heritage. 133,000 km². Marine iguanas, hammerhead sharks, Galápagos penguins.

properties.name: Coral Triangle (SE Asia)
properties.description: Global epicenter of marine biodiversity. 76% of all coral species. 6 countries.

properties.name: Phoenix Islands Protected Area (Kiribati)
properties.description: 408,250 km². Pristine deep-sea coral ecosystems. Commercial fishing banned.

properties.name: North Pacific Whale Migration Route
properties.description: Humpback whale calving corridor. Speed restrictions for commercial vessels.

properties.name: Mariana Trench Marine Monument
properties.description: Deepest point on Earth. Unique deep-sea species. No mining or extraction permitted.

properties.name: Sargasso Sea (No-Nation Protected)
properties.description: Only sea without land boundary. Critical eel spawning habitat. Sargassum biodiversity hotspot.

properties.name: North Atlantic Right Whale Corridor (US East Coast)
properties.description: Critically endangered — ~350 remaining. 10-knot speed restriction mandatory.

properties.name: Azores Marine Park (Portugal)
properties.description: Deep-sea hydrothermal vents. Sperm whales, blue sharks. 900,000 km².

properties.name: Gulf of Guinea (IUU Fishing Hotspot)
properties.description: Highest rate of piracy & IUU fishing globally. Poor monitoring infrastructure.

properties.name: Belize Barrier Reef Reserve
properties.description: UNESCO Heritage. Largest reef in Western Hemisphere. Manatees, marine turtles.

properties.name: Canary Islands Whale Sanctuary
properties.description: Europe's first whale heritage site. Pilot whales, beaked whales. Ship strike risk.

properties.name: Pelagos Sanctuary (Mediterranean)
properties.description: 87,500 km² cetacean sanctuary. Fin whales, sperm whales, striped dolphins.

properties.name: Strait of Gibraltar (Chokepoint)
properties.description: 300+ ships/day. Orca interactions with vessels. Critical migration bottleneck.

properties.name: Wadden Sea (North Sea)
properties.description: UNESCO Heritage. Largest intertidal zone worldwide. 10-12M migratory birds. Harbour seals.

properties.name: Bazaruto Archipelago (Mozambique)
properties.description: Last viable dugong population in East Africa. Manta rays, whale sharks.

properties.name: iSimangaliso Wetland (South Africa)
properties.description: UNESCO Heritage. Leatherback & loggerhead turtle nesting. Humpback whale nursery.

properties.name: Ross Sea Marine Protected Area (Antarctica)
properties.description: World's largest MPA. 1.55M km². Emperor penguins, Weddell seals, Antarctic toothfish.

properties.name: Arctic Northwest Passage
properties.description: Opening due to ice melt. Minimal AIS coverage. Narwhals, polar bears, beluga whales.

properties.name: Patagonian Shelf (Argentina)
properties.description: Southern right whales, elephant seals, Magellanic penguins. Heavy IUU fishing pressure.

properties.name: Fernando de Noronha Marine Park (Brazil)
properties.description: UNESCO Heritage. Spinner dolphins, hawksbill turtles. No-take zone.

properties.name: Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park (Philippines)
properties.description: UNESCO Heritage. 97,000 ha. 360 coral species, 600 fish species. Zero-take.

properties.name: South China Sea (Contested Zone)
properties.description: Geopolitical hotspot. AIS manipulation detected. Reef destruction for militarization.

properties.name: Malacca Strait Chokepoint
properties.description: Busiest shipping lane on Earth. 94,000 ships/year. Collision & piracy risk.

properties.name: Ogasawara Islands (Japan)
properties.description: UNESCO Heritage. 'Oriental Galápagos'. Humpback whales, green turtles, 441 endemic taxa.

properties.name: Channel Islands National Marine Sanctuary (California)
properties.description: Blue whales, sea otters, giant kelp forests. Ship speed zones enforced.

properties.name: Gulf of Mexico Dead Zone
properties.description: Seasonal hypoxic zone. 15,000 km². Oil spill risk area. Endangered Kemp's ridley turtles.

properties.name: Bay of Fundy (Canada)
properties.description: Critical North Atlantic right whale feeding ground. Mandatory speed restrictions.

properties.name: Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary
properties.description: NOAA sanctuary protecting the only living coral barrier reef in the continental U.S.

properties.name: Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary
properties.description: Extensive kelp forests, deep submarine canyon. Sea otters, whales, and seals.

properties.name: Northeast Canyons & Seamounts
properties.description: U.S. Marine National Monument. Deep-sea corals, endangered whales, sea turtles.

properties.name: Rose Atoll Marine National Monument
properties.description: American Samoa. Pristine coral reef. Important nesting site for green turtles.

properties.name: Palau National Marine Sanctuary
properties.description: 500,000 km² sanctuary covering 80% of Palau's EEZ. Zero-take zone protecting sharks and rays.

properties.name: Bowie Seamount MPA (Canada)
properties.description: Rare shallow seamount. Complex ecosystem of corals, sponges, and rockfish.

properties.name: OSPAR MPA (North-East Atlantic)
properties.description: Network of MPAs protecting vulnerable deep-sea habitats and ecosystems in the high seas.

properties.name: Coral Sea Marine Park (Australia)
properties.description: 989,836 km² ocean wilderness protecting remote coral reefs, seamounts, and abyssal plains.

properties.name: South Orkney Islands MPA
properties.description: 94,000 km² CCAMLR protected area. No-fishing zone protecting penguin and seal habitats.

properties.name: Pitcairn Islands Marine Reserve
properties.description: 830,000 km² Highly protected UK overseas territory. One of the largest intact marine ecosystems.
